title: Theme colour config
description: A theme's colour decisions (docs/foundation.md#colour-model). tools/colour.mjs validates the rules this schema can't express (the accent and a tint's from naming a defined slot) and generates tokens.colour.json.

pins.description: Steps held at hand-set values; unpinned steps follow the tone curve bent through them.

brand.description: Up to four brand colours in numbered slots (F7d): numbered, not ranked. At least one is defined; accent names the defined slot that actions, links, focus and selection read.

name.description: Optional; shown in the library and token descriptions. Default: Brand colour N.

accent.description: The slot the accent reuses; must be defined. Default 1.

base.description: Base colours: black, white and the greys between, always needed. Neutral by default; warm, cool or tinted for the brand's mood.

tint.description: Tints the greys with a hue: a hand-set colour or a brand colour, one of them.

from.description: A brand colour slot, or accent.

strength.description: OKLCH chroma of the tint; at most 0.04 so the base stays greys.

purpose.description: Required: what the set is for and what it must never be used for. Emitted into each token's $extensions so agents use it correctly.

roles.description: Purpose-scoped exception (Q44): "category" makes this set the category colours. The generator emits public roles color.category.1..n (in member order, the same in every context) and color.category.on-1..n (ink, 4.5:1), and checks each member at 3:1 on every surface in every context. Components read only those roles, never set.* directly; status roles never read them. At most one set may claim it. "ai" (Q56) makes this set the AI processing gradient: public roles color.ai.1..n (gradient stops, each 3:1 on every surface), read only by the AI processing state; never status, never focus or selection. At most one set may claim each.
